vessels.description: every vessel row in the main tabular list on these pages, read top to bottom; each printed table row is exactly one item; skip the running page/column header rows and the numbered footnote lines printed below the horizontal rule at the bottom of the page (the 'Formerly ...' notes). a row is atomic: it never continues onto the next page, so extract every row that is fully printed on the page

officialNumber.description: the vessel's official number printed in the leftmost 'Official No.' column, as an integer

rig.description: the rig/propulsion abbreviation printed in the 'Rig' column, transcribed exactly as printed including its periods (the list uses a small set of short standard abbreviations); exclude any leading asterisk or other reference mark that precedes the abbreviation; null when the column is blank for this row

vesselName.description: the vessel name printed in the 'Name of vessel' column, transcribed verbatim as printed. exclude any leading superscript footnote-reference digit that points to a 'Formerly' note. keep the name's own internal punctuation, initials, and any parenthetical qualifier that is part of the printed name; letter-spaced names are transcribed as the ordinary word they spell

grossTonnage.description: the value printed in the 'Gross tonnage' column, as a number; null when blank

netTonnage.description: the value printed in the 'Net tonnage' column, as a number; null when blank

service.description: the abbreviation printed in the 'Service' column, transcribed exactly as printed including its period; null when the column is blank for this row

crew.description: the integer printed in the 'Crew' column; null when blank

whenBuilt.description: the four-digit year printed in the 'When built' column, as an integer; null when blank
